text: SELECT * FROM customers;
label: Retrieves all columns and rows from the customers table.

text: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, email FROM customers WHERE active = true;
label: Fetches the ID, name, and email of all active customers.

text: SELECT order_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 500;
label: Returns all orders where the total amount exceeds $500.

text: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 10 AND 50;
label: Lists products priced between $10 and $50.

text: SELECT employee_id, first_name, department FROM employees WHERE department IN ('Engineering', 'Product', 'Design');
label: Retrieves employees who work in Engineering, Product, or Design departments.

text: SELECT post_id, title, created_at FROM posts WHERE created_at > '2024-01-01';
label: Fetches all posts published after January 1, 2024.

text: SELECT account_id, balance FROM accounts WHERE balance IS NULL;
label: Returns all accounts that have no balance recorded.

text: SELECT patient_id, full_name FROM patients WHERE last_name LIKE 'Smith%';
label: Finds all patients whose last name starts with Smith.

text: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products;
label: Returns a deduplicated list of all product categories.

text: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM customers WHERE active = true;
label: Lists each unique country where an active customer is located.

text: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;
label: Counts the total number of orders placed by each customer.

text: SELECT department, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department;
label: Calculates the average salary for each department.

text: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_sold FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id HAVING SUM(quantity) > 100;
label: Identifies products that have sold more than 100 units in total.

text: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM employees GROUP BY department HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;
label: Lists departments with more than 10 employees.

text: SELECT user_id, COUNT(post_id) AS post_count FROM posts GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(post_id) >= 5;
label: Finds users who have published at least 5 posts.

text: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, o.order_id, o.total_amount FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;
label: Returns all customers along with their associated orders, excluding customers with no orders.

text: SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, d.department_name FROM employees e INNER JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id;
label: Joins employees with their department names.

text: SELECT p.product_name, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price FROM products p INNER JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id;
label: Retrieves each product alongside the quantity and price recorded in order line items.

text: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, o.order_id FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;
label: Lists all customers and their orders, including customers who have never placed an order.

text: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id;
label: Returns all employees and their department, showing NULL for employees not assigned to a department.

text: SELECT u.username, p.title FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE p.post_id IS NULL;
label: Finds all users who have never made a post.

text: SELECT p.post_id, p.title, c.comment_text FROM posts p RIGHT JOIN comments c ON p.post_id = c.post_id;
label: Returns all comments and the post they belong to, including any orphaned comments.

text: SELECT a.account_id, t.transaction_id, t.amount FROM accounts a RIGHT JOIN transactions t ON a.account_id = t.account_id;
label: Lists all transactions and their associated accounts, including transactions with no matching account.

text: SELECT o.order_id, o.total_amount, c.first_name, c.email FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC LIMIT 10;
label: Returns the top 10 highest-value orders along with the customer name and email.

text: SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 5;
label: Lists the 5 cheapest products by price.

text: SELECT employee_id, first_name, salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 20;
label: Returns the 20 highest-paid employees.

text: SELECT post_id, title, view_count FROM posts ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 10;
label: Retrieves the 10 most-viewed posts.

text: SELECT patient_id, full_name, appointment_date FROM appointments ORDER BY appointment_date ASC LIMIT 50;
label: Lists the next 50 earliest scheduled appointments.

text: SELECT customer_id, first_name, CASE WHEN total_spent > 10000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN total_spent > 5000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN total_spent > 1000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS tier FROM customers;
label: Assigns each customer a loyalty tier (Platinum, Gold, Silver, or Bronze) based on their total spending.

text: SELECT employee_id, first_name, salary, CASE WHEN salary > 100000 THEN 'Senior' WHEN salary > 60000 THEN 'Mid' ELSE 'Junior' END AS band FROM employees;
label: Labels each employee as Senior, Mid, or Junior based on their salary.

text: SELECT order_id, status, CASE WHEN status = 'shipped' THEN 'In Transit' WHEN status = 'delivered' THEN 'Complete' WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 'Closed' ELSE 'Pending' END AS display_status FROM orders;
label: Maps each order status code to a user-friendly display label.

text: SELECT transaction_id, amount, CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN 'Debit' ELSE 'Credit' END AS direction FROM transactions;
label: Classifies each transaction as a Debit or Credit based on whether the amount is negative.

text: SELECT employee_id, first_name, salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC) AS salary_rank FROM employees;
label: Ranks each employee by salary within their department, with rank 1 being the highest earner.

text: SELECT order_id, customer_id, total_amount, SUM(total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date) AS running_total FROM orders;
label: Calculates a running cumulative spend per customer in order-date sequence.

text: SELECT transaction_id, account_id, amount, LAG(amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY transaction_date) AS prev_amount FROM transactions;
label: Returns each transaction alongside the previous transaction amount for the same account.

text: SELECT post_id, user_id, view_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY view_count DESC) AS view_rank FROM posts;
label: Ranks each user's posts by view count, with ties receiving the same rank.

text: SELECT employee_id, salary, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY salary) AS quartile FROM employees;
label: Divides employees into four salary quartiles from lowest to highest paid.

text: WITH top_customers AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) AS lifetime_value FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.first_name, c.email, tc.lifetime_value FROM customers c INNER JOIN top_customers tc ON c.customer_id = tc.customer_id WHERE tc.lifetime_value > 5000;
label: Identifies customers whose total historical spend exceeds $5,000 using a common table expression.

text: WITH dept_avg AS (SELECT department_id, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department_id) SELECT e.first_name, e.salary, da.avg_salary FROM employees e INNER JOIN dept_avg da ON e.department_id = da.department_id WHERE e.salary > da.avg_salary;
label: Returns employees who earn above their own department's average salary.

text: WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue FROM monthly_revenue;
label: Computes monthly revenue and compares each month to the prior month's revenue.

text: WITH active_users AS (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE last_login > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') SELECT p.post_id, p.title FROM posts p WHERE p.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users);
label: Retrieves posts written by users who have logged in within the last 30 days.

text: SELECT product_id, product_name FROM products WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items WHERE quantity > 50);
label: Lists products that have appeared in an order line with a quantity greater than 50.

text: SELECT employee_id, first_name FROM employees WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees);
label: Returns all employees who earn more than the company-wide average salary.

text: SELECT customer_id, first_name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_date > '2024-01-01');
label: Finds customers who have not placed any orders since January 1, 2024.

text: SELECT department_id, department_name FROM departments WHERE department_id IN (SELECT department_id FROM employees WHERE salary > 90000);
label: Lists departments that have at least one employee earning over $90,000.

text: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products UNION SELECT product_id, product_name, list_price FROM archived_products;
label: Combines the current product catalog with archived products into a single deduplicated list.

text: SELECT customer_id, email FROM customers WHERE region = 'West' UNION ALL SELECT customer_id, email FROM leads WHERE region = 'West';
label: Merges West-region customers and West-region leads into one list, keeping duplicates.

text: SELECT employee_id, email FROM employees WHERE department = 'Engineering' UNION SELECT contractor_id, email FROM contractors WHERE department = 'Engineering';
label: Returns a combined list of Engineering employee and contractor email addresses.

text: SELECT user_id FROM posts WHERE created_at > '2024-06-01' UNION SELECT user_id FROM comments WHERE created_at > '2024-06-01';
label: Returns a unique list of user IDs who either posted or commented after June 1, 2024.

text: SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM customers WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01';
label: Retrieves all customers who registered during the year 2024.

text: SELECT order_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' AND total_amount > 200;
label: Returns pending orders with a value greater than $200.

text: SELECT appointment_id, patient_id, scheduled_at FROM appointments WHERE doctor_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'confirmed';
label: Returns confirmed appointments that have been assigned to a doctor.

text: INSERT INTO customers (first_name, last_name, email, created_at) VALUES ('Jane', 'Doe', 'jane.doe@example.com', NOW());
label: Adds a new customer record for Jane Doe with a timestamp of the current time.

text: INSERT INTO orders (customer_id, total_amount, status, order_date) VALUES (42, 299.99, 'pending', CURRENT_DATE);
label: Creates a new pending order for customer 42 with a total of $299.99 dated today.

text: INSERT INTO employees (first_name, last_name, department_id, salary, hire_date) VALUES ('Carlos', 'Ruiz', 3, 85000, '2024-09-01');
label: Adds a new employee, Carlos Ruiz, to department 3 with a $85,000 salary starting September 2024.

text: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, title, body, status, created_at) VALUES (7, 'Year in Review', 'This year was transformative...', 'draft', NOW());
label: Creates a new draft post titled Year in Review for user 7.

text: INSERT INTO transactions (account_id, amount, transaction_type, transaction_date) VALUES (101, -150.00, 'withdrawal', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
label: Records a $150 withdrawal transaction against account 101.

text: INSERT INTO products (product_name, category, price, stock_quantity) VALUES ('Wireless Earbuds Pro', 'Electronics', 79.99, 500);
label: Adds a new electronics product, Wireless Earbuds Pro, priced at $79.99 with 500 units in stock.

text: INSERT INTO appointments (patient_id, doctor_id, scheduled_at, reason) VALUES (55, 12, '2025-02-14 09:00:00', 'Annual Checkup');
label: Books an annual checkup appointment for patient 55 with doctor 12 on February 14, 2025.

text: INSERT INTO departments (department_name, manager_id, budget) VALUES ('Data Science', 8, 500000);
label: Creates a new Data Science department managed by employee 8 with a $500,000 budget.

text: INSERT INTO accounts (customer_id, account_type, balance, opened_at) VALUES (23, 'savings', 0.00, NOW());
label: Opens a new savings account with a zero balance for customer 23.

text: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, comment_text, created_at) VALUES (18, 5, 'Great read!', NOW());
label: Adds a comment saying Great read! from user 5 on post 18.

text: INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price) VALUES (301, 77, 3, 24.99);
label: Adds 3 units of product 77 at $24.99 each to order 301.

text: INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, created_at) SELECT username, email, password_hash, NOW() FROM staging_users WHERE verified = true;
label: Migrates all verified users from the staging table into the production users table.

text: INSERT INTO patients (full_name, dob, gender, phone) VALUES ('Aisha Patel', '1985-07-22', 'F', '555-0190');
label: Registers a new patient, Aisha Patel, with her date of birth, gender, and phone number.

text: INSERT INTO transactions (account_id, amount, transaction_type, transaction_date) SELECT account_id, interest_amount, 'interest', CURRENT_DATE FROM account_interest_accruals WHERE accrual_date = CURRENT_DATE;
label: Posts today's accrued interest amounts as credit transactions for each account.

text: INSERT INTO products (product_name, category, price, stock_quantity) VALUES ('Standing Desk', 'Furniture', 349.00, 80);
label: Adds a standing desk to the Furniture category priced at $349 with 80 units available.

text: UPDATE customers SET email = 'jane.new@example.com' WHERE customer_id = 101;
label: Updates the email address for the customer with ID 101.

text: UPDATE orders SET status = 'shipped', shipped_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = 4523;
label: Marks order 4523 as shipped and records the current timestamp as the ship time.

text: UPDATE employees SET salary = salary * 1.05 WHERE department = 'Engineering' AND performance_rating >= 4;
label: Gives a 5% salary raise to Engineering employees with a performance rating of 4 or higher.

text: UPDATE products SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - 10 WHERE product_id = 88;
label: Decrements the stock quantity of product 88 by 10 units.

text: UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + 500.00 WHERE account_id = 207;
label: Credits $500 to the balance of account 207.

text: UPDATE posts SET status = 'published', published_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = 34;
label: Publishes post 34 and records the current time as the publish timestamp.

text: UPDATE patients SET phone = '555-0234' WHERE patient_id = 19;
label: Updates the phone number on file for patient 19.

text: UPDATE transactions SET flagged = true WHERE amount > 10000 AND transaction_date = CURRENT_DATE;
label: Flags all transactions over $10,000 that occurred today for review.

text: UPDATE employees SET department_id = 5 WHERE department_id = 3 AND hire_date < '2020-01-01';
label: Moves all employees hired before 2020 from department 3 into department 5.

text: UPDATE orders SET discount_amount = total_amount * 0.10 WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE tier = 'Platinum');
label: Applies a 10% discount to all orders placed by Platinum-tier customers.

text: UPDATE users SET last_login = NOW() WHERE user_id = 88;
label: Updates the last login timestamp for user 88 to the current time.

text: UPDATE products SET price = price * 0.85 WHERE category = 'Electronics' AND stock_quantity > 200;
label: Reduces prices by 15% for electronics products with more than 200 units in stock.

text: UPDATE appointments SET status = 'cancelled' WHERE scheduled_at < NOW() AND status = 'pending';
label: Cancels all appointments whose scheduled time has already passed and are still marked pending.

text: UPDATE departments SET manager_id = 14 WHERE department_name = 'Marketing';
label: Reassigns the Marketing department manager to employee 14.

text: UPDATE accounts SET account_type = 'premium' WHERE balance > 50000;
label: Upgrades all accounts with a balance over $50,000 to premium status.

text: DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires_at < NOW();
label: Removes all expired user sessions from the sessions table.

text: DELETE FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date < '2023-01-01';
label: Purges cancelled orders that are older than January 2023.

text: DELETE FROM employees WHERE termination_date IS NOT NULL AND termination_date < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 years';
label: Removes employee records for staff terminated more than two years ago.

text: DELETE FROM comments WHERE user_id = 77;
label: Deletes all comments posted by user 77.

text: DELETE FROM products WHERE stock_quantity = 0 AND discontinued = true;
label: Removes discontinued products that are completely out of stock.

text: DELETE FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date < '2020-01-01';
label: Deletes all transaction records older than January 2020.

text: DELETE FROM appointments WHERE patient_id = 55 AND status = 'cancelled';
label: Removes all cancelled appointments for patient 55.

text: DELETE FROM posts WHERE status = 'draft' AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days';
label: Deletes draft posts that have not been published within the last 90 days.

text: DELETE FROM customers WHERE active = false AND last_order_date < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 years';
label: Removes inactive customer accounts with no orders in the past three years.

text: DELETE FROM users WHERE email_verified = false AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days';
label: Deletes unverified user accounts that are more than 7 days old.

text: DELETE FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled');
label: Removes all line items belonging to cancelled orders.

text: DELETE FROM accounts WHERE balance = 0 AND account_type = 'checking' AND opened_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year';
label: Closes empty checking accounts that have been open for over a year with no activity.

text: DELETE FROM departments WHERE department_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT department_id FROM employees WHERE department_id IS NOT NULL);
label: Removes departments that have no employees assigned to them.

text: DELETE FROM patients WHERE dob IS NULL AND full_name IS NULL;
label: Cleans up patient records that are missing both name and date of birth.

text: DELETE FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM order_items);
label: Deletes products that have never appeared in any order.

text: CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, first_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, last_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL, active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW());
label: Creates the customers table with a unique email, active flag, and automatic timestamp.

text: CREATE TABLE orders (order_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(customer_id), total_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'pending', order_date DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE);
label: Creates the orders table with a foreign key to customers and a default status of pending.

text: CREATE TABLE employees (employee_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, first_name VARCHAR(100), last_name VARCHAR(100), department_id INTEGER REFERENCES departments(department_id), salary NUMERIC(12, 2), hire_date DATE);
label: Creates the employees table referencing departments with salary and hire date fields.

text: CREATE TABLE transactions (transaction_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), account_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_id), amount NUMERIC(15, 2) NOT NULL, transaction_type VARCHAR(50), transaction_date TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW());
label: Creates the transactions table with a UUID primary key and a foreign key to accounts.

text: CREATE TABLE posts (post_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id), title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, body TEXT, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'draft', created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW());
label: Creates the posts table with a foreign key to users and draft as the default status.

text: CREATE TABLE appointments (appointment_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, patient_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(patient_id), doctor_id INTEGER REFERENCES doctors(doctor_id), scheduled_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, reason TEXT, status VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'pending');
label: Creates the appointments table linking patients to doctors with a scheduled time and status.

text: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer_id ON orders(customer_id);
label: Creates an index on the customer_id column of the orders table to speed up customer order lookups.

text: CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_account_date ON transactions(account_id, transaction_date DESC);
label: Creates a composite index on account_id and transaction_date for fast per-account transaction history queries.

text: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_customers_email ON customers(email);
label: Creates a unique index on the email column of the customers table to enforce email uniqueness.

text: CREATE INDEX idx_posts_user_status ON posts(user_id, status) WHERE status = 'published';
label: Creates a partial index on published posts per user to accelerate published-post queries.

text: ALTER TABLE employees ADD COLUMN termination_date DATE;
label: Adds an optional termination date column to the employees table.

text: ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN discontinued BOOLEAN DEFAULT false;
label: Adds a discontinued flag to the products table, defaulting to false for all existing rows.

text: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN shipped_at TIMESTAMP;
label: Adds a shipped timestamp column to the orders table to record when an order was dispatched.

text: ALTER TABLE customers ALTER COLUMN email SET NOT NULL;
label: Enforces that the email column in the customers table can no longer contain null values.

text: ALTER TABLE accounts ADD CONSTRAINT chk_balance_non_negative CHECK (balance >= 0);
label: Adds a constraint to prevent the account balance from being set to a negative value.

text: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name, e.salary, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.department_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS dept_salary_rank FROM employees e INNER JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id;
label: Ranks each employee by salary within their department without gaps in rank numbering.

text: WITH cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS cohort_month FROM customers), activity AS (SELECT o.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS order_month FROM orders o) SELECT c.cohort_month, a.order_month, COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS retained FROM cohort c JOIN activity a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;
label: Builds a monthly cohort retention table showing how many customers from each signup month placed orders in subsequent months.

text: SELECT p.post_id, p.title, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS comment_count, SUM(COUNT(c.comment_id)) OVER () AS total_comments, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(c.comment_id) / SUM(COUNT(c.comment_id)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total FROM posts p LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.post_id = c.post_id GROUP BY p.post_id, p.title ORDER BY comment_count DESC;
label: Ranks posts by comment count and shows each post's share of total comments across the platform.

text: SELECT a.account_id, a.balance, t.amount, t.transaction_date, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.account_id ORDER BY t.transaction_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_balance FROM accounts a JOIN transactions t ON a.account_id = t.account_id;
label: Computes a running balance for each account by accumulating transaction amounts in date order.

text: SELECT u.username, COUNT(DISTINCT p.post_id) AS posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.comment_id) AS comments FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.user_id = c.user_id GROUP BY u.username ORDER BY posts DESC, comments DESC;
label: Summarizes each user's total number of posts and comments, sorted by most active first.

text: SELECT product_id, product_name, price, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) AS price_percentile FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics';
label: Shows where each electronics product falls in the price distribution as a percentile rank.

text: SELECT t.account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'deposit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits, SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'withdrawal' THEN ABS(t.amount) ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals FROM transactions t GROUP BY t.account_id;
label: Pivots transactions to show total deposits and total withdrawals side by side for each account.

text: SELECT doctor_id, COUNT(*) AS total_appointments, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_time - scheduled_at)) / 60) AS avg_duration_minutes FROM appointments WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY doctor_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;
label: Returns doctors with more than 20 completed appointments along with their average appointment duration in minutes.
